digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must resolve to Bedrock inference profiles via layered config file (REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE) without modifying deprecated bare REBAR_LLM_MODEL or infra/
All three gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must run end-to-end against Bedrock, parse verdicts, validate structured output, and show zero direct-Anthropic calls
Prompt caching must actively engage on the Bedrock path, demonstrated by nonzero cache_read_tokens across multiple calls within a single gate run
Bedrock cachePoint TTL defaults to 5 minutes matching Anthropic cache_control default, requiring no observable behavioral difference or per-provider tuning
Developer opt-in and revert must be documented in docs/local-dev-env.md with revert executable in one step via environment variable change
